professional_authority_firewall: Control readiness, evidence coverage and remediation state are not legal, regulatory, accounting, tax, accessibility, cybersecurity or other professional certification.

controls.title: Stable identity continuity
controls.objective: Every institutional subject uses a stable public identity with versioned fingerprints and governed continuity evidence.

controls.title: Public/private identity separation
controls.objective: Public references cannot reveal private immutable identity mappings or raw resolver data.

controls.title: Authentication assurance
controls.objective: Authentication methods, session state and assurance levels are explicit and evidence-bound.

controls.title: Credential and session lifecycle
controls.objective: Creation, expiry, rotation, revocation and recovery are versioned and independently observable.

controls.title: Least privilege and purpose binding
controls.objective: Capabilities are scoped to exact operation, purpose, subject, expiry and use limit.

controls.title: Separation of duties
controls.objective: Originators, approvers and independent verifiers remain distinct where material state changes occur.

controls.title: Billing idempotency and reconciliation
controls.objective: Charge, invoice, meter and adjustment events are idempotent and reconciled to institutional records.

controls.title: Provider billing is not institutional truth
controls.objective: Provider success, included quota or payment response cannot directly manufacture CrownThrive economic state.

controls.title: Versioned license and entitlement scope
controls.objective: Every license and entitlement binds exact version, subject, offer, rights and exclusions.

controls.title: Renewal, expiry, revocation and supersession
controls.objective: License state changes preserve history and customer/provider continuity.

controls.title: Least-data event taxonomy
controls.objective: Analytics events collect only minimum necessary fields and exclude credentials, private identities and protected evidence.

controls.title: Metric provenance and freshness
controls.objective: Metrics identify source, observation window, confidence, freshness and reconciliation state.

controls.title: Consent and preference enforcement
controls.objective: Notification channels respect purpose, consent, preference, suppression and opt-out state.

controls.title: Delivery, retry and duplicate control
controls.objective: Notification delivery uses bounded retries, deduplication and evidence of failure or completion.

controls.title: Customer and tenant data boundary
controls.objective: CRM data is tenant-scoped, purpose-limited and not duplicated into unnecessary archives.

controls.title: Lifecycle event integrity
controls.objective: Lead, contact, account, opportunity and customer state changes are event-based and traceable.

controls.title: Case and evidence continuity
controls.objective: Tickets, cases, evidence and remedies maintain immutable chronology and source links.

controls.title: Escalation and SLA governance
controls.objective: Priority, escalation, response targets and reserved human actions are explicit and measurable.

controls.title: Index source and version lineage
controls.objective: Search results trace to exact source, version, classification and freshness state.

controls.title: Access-aware result filtering
controls.objective: Search never bypasses authorization, tenant, license or public/private boundaries.

controls.title: Offer, order, fulfillment and settlement separation
controls.objective: Commercial lifecycle states remain distinct and cannot be collapsed by provider success.

controls.title: Refund, dispute and compensation behavior
controls.objective: Economic corrections are idempotent, auditable and preserve the original record.

controls.title: Exact contract and provider binding
controls.objective: Every route binds exact source, destination, contract version, mapping and capability.

controls.title: Failover, rollback and readback
controls.objective: Routes define bounded retry, failover, rollback, compensation and read-after-write evidence.

controls.title: Earning and entitlement truth
controls.objective: Reward earnings, credits and benefits require reconciled qualifying events and exact rules.

controls.title: Reversal, expiry and liability control
controls.objective: Reward reversals, expiry, breakage and liabilities remain traceable and compensating.

controls.title: Source control and published readback
controls.objective: Documentation changes bind exact source, branch, commit, navigation and published/current readback.

controls.title: Public/private projection and retention
controls.objective: Public documentation excludes secrets and protected implementation while preserving restricted human and machine continuity.

certification_rule: No control is certified without exact current evidence and a different verifier.
